notes: Unique. Banner DEFENSIVE SHIELD (slip frame: red Effect top edge fading into the teal shield frame). Printed base is a Tatooine Effect. No grabber box. Slip heading and caption both •; match the base. Slip prints ▲ ('may ▲ an Immediate Effect') where the wiki stub expands it ('may take an Immediate Effect into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'); otherwise identical. Lore matches the wiki and the 350 px scan (no correction). Copyright read off the 350 px scan: Tatooine 2001 SE-style line with year after the first ©. Base also prints an Episode I icon (printed-card feature). Modern: VSh-D-fanfare-pre.gif (350 px). Art from the base scan, not the modern VSh shield face: the shield frame's art window is narrower and left a cyan strip down the right edge of the art box.
